cloud.title: Cloud Security Misconfiguration
cloud.subtitle: SecureGuard Red Team vs TechCorp Cloud
cloud.description: Exploit misconfigured S3 buckets, extract developer IAM credentials, escalate privileges, and extract secrets from AWS Secrets Manager.

mod1.title: Stage 1: Public S3 Bucket Enumeration
mod1.story: Enumerate unauthenticated public S3 storage buckets.
mod1.mission: Locate and download the company public bucket file to retrieve flag 1.

mod2.title: Stage 2: Developer Credentials Extraction
mod2.story: Extract plaintext or obfuscated AWS developer access keys.
mod2.mission: Decode system logs to extract developer AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

mod3.title: Stage 3: Cloud Reconnaissance & S3 Enumeration
mod3.story: Perform authenticated AWS API reconnaissance using configured AWS CLI profile.
mod3.mission: List internal user identity and locate restricted cloud buckets.

mod4.title: Stage 4: IAM Policy Analysis & Privilege Escalation
mod4.story: Analyze attached IAM inline policies and exploit wildcards.
mod4.mission: Attach administrator policy or wildcard action policy to escalate developer privileges.

mod5.title: Stage 5: Secrets Manager Access & Final Flag
mod5.story: Access company secret store using administrator privileges.
mod5.mission: Retrieve company/final/flag secret from AWS Secrets Manager.
